strings.app.subtitle: OLED monitoring canvas · Live layouts · Pixel-friendly filters
strings.source.hint: Start with no windows for a black canvas, or add, remove, and switch windows while active.
strings.page.monitor_description: Choose the target display and windows to monitor
strings.page.layout_description: Arrange monitored windows on the secondary display
strings.page.filters_description: Adjust rendering style and output brightness
strings.page.protection_description: Configure drift black rests and capture performance
strings.status.ready: Ready · With no windows selected, the target display stays black
strings.layout.help: While secondary-screen mode is active, press Ctrl+Alt+L. Pointer-triggered hiding is suspended so you can drag windows directly on the secondary display or resize them from the bottom-right corner. Press the shortcut again to save.
strings.layout.empty: Select windows to preview the layout
strings.layout.overlay_banner: EDIT LAYOUT  ·  Drag / resize bottom-right  ·  Ctrl+Alt+L to save
strings.filter.edge_tip: Contours grow only into brighter regions. Lower values retain more detail; 12–28 is recommended for text.
strings.filter.explanation: Inner contours avoid expanding into the black background and reduce the lit area. Lower brightness reduces pixel load, while hue cycling distributes color-channel use. These features do not replace the panel's built-in pixel refresh.
strings.protection.resolution_tip: When enabled, each window is cached at up to about one megapixel. Disable it to retain the source window's full resolution.
strings.tray.still_running_body: Use the system tray to restore the control panel or quit.
strings.status.live_switch: Monitoring {count} windows · Selection can be changed live
strings.status.layout_saved: Manual layout saved · Pointer-triggered hiding restored
strings.status.start_before_edit: Start secondary-screen mode before pressing Ctrl+Alt+L to edit the layout.
strings.status.layout_editing: Editing layout · Drag on the secondary display; resize from bottom-right; press Ctrl+Alt+L to finish
strings.status.black_only: Target display stays black · Move the pointer onto it to restore the desktop
strings.status.paused: The secondary canvas is hidden; window capture remains active in the background.
strings.status.backends: Monitoring {count} windows · {summary} · Selection can be changed live
strings.status.source_closed: A source window closed; the remaining windows are still being monitored.
strings.status.source_closed_black: The final source window closed · Switched to blackout protection
strings.status.screen_removed: The target display was disconnected, so secondary-screen mode stopped safely.
strings.dialog.select_window: Select at least one window to monitor.
strings.language.changed_body: Restart SideScreenUtil to apply the selected language throughout the interface.
strings.capture.wgc_fallback: WGC is unavailable; using PrintWindow instead: {error}
strings.capture.invalid_size: The source window has an invalid size
